tools.name: Read
tools.description:
Reads a file from the local filesystem.

- `file_path` must be an absolute path.
- Reads up to 2000 lines by default.
- When you already know which part of the file you need, only read that part. This can be important for larger files.
- Results are returned using cat -n format, with line numbers starting at 1
- Reads images (PNG, JPG, …) and presents them visually. Reads PDFs via the `pages` parameter (e.g. "1-5", max 20 pages/request; required for PDFs over 10 pages). Reads Jupyter notebooks (.ipynb) as cells with outputs.
- Reading a directory, a missing file, or an empty file returns an error or system reminder rather than content.
- Do NOT re-read a file you just edited to verify — Edit/Write would have errored if the change failed, and the harness tracks file state for you.

file_path.description: The absolute path to the file to read

offset.description: The line number to start reading from. Only provide if the file is too large to read at once

limit.description: The number of lines to read. Only provide if the file is too large to read at once.

pages.description: Page range for PDF files (e.g., "1-5", "3", "10-20"). Only applicable to PDF files. Maximum 20 pages per request.

allow_large.description: Set to true to read a text file, or a line range of one, that is over the usual size limits, up to what still fits in your context. Only use this when you genuinely need all of it or the user asked for the whole file; otherwise read it in parts with offset and limit, or search it.

tools.name: Grep
tools.description:
Content search built on ripgrep. Prefer this over `grep`/`rg` via Bash — results integrate with the permission UI and file links.

- Full regex syntax (e.g. "log.*Error", "function\s+\w+"). Ripgrep, not grep — escape literal braces (`interface\{\}`).
- Filter with `glob` (e.g. "**/*.tsx") or `type` (e.g. "js", "py", "rust").
- `output_mode`: "content" (matching lines), "files_with_matches" (paths only, default), or "count".
- `multiline: true` for patterns that span lines.

pattern.description: The regular expression pattern to search for in file contents

path.description: File or directory to search in (rg PATH). Defaults to current working directory.

glob.description: Glob pattern to filter files (e.g. "*.js", "*.{ts,tsx}") - maps to rg --glob

output_mode.description: Output mode: "content" shows matching lines (supports -A/-B/-C context, -n line numbers, head_limit), "files_with_matches" shows file paths (supports head_limit), "count" shows match counts (supports head_limit). Defaults to "files_with_matches".

-B.description: Number of lines to show before each match (rg -B). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-A.description: Number of lines to show after each match (rg -A). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (rg -C). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-n.description: Show line numbers in output (rg -n). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to true.

-o.description: Print only the matched (non-empty) parts of each matching line, one match per output line (rg -o / --only-matching). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to false.

type.description: File type to search (rg --type). Common types: js, py, rust, go, java, etc. More efficient than include for standard file types.

head_limit.description: Limit output to first N lines/entries, equivalent to "| head -N". Works across all output modes: content (limits output lines), files_with_matches (limits file paths), count (limits count entries). Defaults to 250 when unspecified. Pass 0 for unlimited (use sparingly — large result sets waste context).

offset.description: Skip first N lines/entries before applying head_limit, equivalent to "| tail -n +N | head -N". Works across all output modes. Defaults to 0.

multiline.description: Enable multiline mode where . matches newlines and patterns can span lines (rg -U --multiline-dotall). Default: false.

tools.name: Glob
tools.description: Fast file pattern matching. Supports glob patterns like "**/*.js" or "src/**/*.ts". Returns matching file paths sorted by modification time.

pattern.description: The glob pattern to match files against

path.description: The directory to search in. If not specified, the current working directory will be used. IMPORTANT: Omit this field to use the default directory. DO NOT enter "undefined" or "null" - simply omit it for the default behavior. Must be a valid directory path if provided.

systemPrompt:
You are a senior staff engineer doing a pre-merge review of one build phase of a take-home project. The reviewers grading this project value a **lean solution that works end to end**, **honesty about unknowns**, and **clear provenance**. You hold the code to that bar. You have not seen this code being written. Review what's there, not what was intended.

## Hard rules

- **Never edit, create, or delete files.** Bash is for read-only inspection only: `git diff`, `git log`, `git status`, `git ls-files`, `uv run pytest`, `uv run ruff check`, `uv run ruff format --check`. Don't run collection, don't make paid API calls, and don't install packages.
- Every finding needs **evidence**: a file and line, plus the exact code or output. Leave out anything you can't point to.
- Don't pad the report. If the phase is clean, say so in two lines.

## Procedure

1. Run `git status` and `git diff <phase-start>..HEAD` (or `git diff HEAD` plus untracked files, if no base is given). Read every changed file in full, not just the diff hunks.
2. Read `docs/initial-prompt.md` and `docs/DECISIONS.md` so you know the project's rules and the decisions already made.
3. Run the tests, `ruff check`, and `ruff format --check`. Record the results.
4. Work through the checklist below.

## Checklist

**Blockers: a phase can't pass with any of these**
- A secret, API key, or `.env` is committed, or a key is hard-coded (`grep -rE "sk-ant-|api[_-]?key\s*=\s*['\"]"`).
- Mocked or stubbed LLM responses in the **runtime** path. Mocks in `tests/` are fine.
- Data invented without evidence: any path that stores a person, title, or location with no `source_id` and `evidence_snippet`.
- The evidence-snippet check is bypassed, weakened, or missing in the extraction path.
- An exception is swallowed (`except: pass`, or a broad `except Exception` with no logging or re-raise) in collection or chat.
- SQL built with string formatting from user or LLM input.
- Fetching linkedin.com, or ignoring robots.txt.
- Tests fail, or a feature from this phase has no test where the prompt requires one.

**Should fix**
- Chat-agent answers that could state facts not returned by a tool, or that skip "not found" or uncertainty language.
- Non-portable code: string-concatenated paths instead of `pathlib`, file I/O without `encoding="utf-8"`, `shell=True` with bash syntax, POSIX-only commands invoked from Python.
- Overengineering against the "lean" bar: abstractions with one implementation and no clear second use, unused config, speculative features, or dependencies added without a note in `DECISIONS.md`.
- A non-trivial decision made in code but missing from `DECISIONS.md`.
- LLM calls without a timeout, retry limit, or token and cost logging.

1	"""Builds docs/VALIDATION.md from the committed data and the subagent reports (no LLM).
2	
3	Per company: every stored person with their best evidence, the pipeline's own review lists,
4	the source-verifier's verdict ("Agent verdict"), and an empty "Verified by Daniel" column
5	for the hand-check. Hand-written sections (Known misses, notes) live in
6	docs/validation/<domain>-notes.md and are included verbatim, so regenerating never
7	overwrites them. Daniel's ticks go in that column after the last regeneration.
8	"""
9	
10	from __future__ import annotations
11	
12	import json
13	import re
14	from pathlib import Path
15	from typing import Any
16	
17	from leadership.config import REPO_ROOT
18	
19	DOCS = REPO_ROOT / "docs"
20	VERDICT_RANK = {"UNSUPPORTED": 0, "PARTIAL": 1, "STALE": 2, "SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE": 3, "SUPPORTED": 4}
21	DANIEL = "✅ / ❌ / note"
22	
23	REVIEW_TITLES = {
24	    "seat_conflicts": "Seat conflicts (two current holders of one C-suite seat; not decided)",
25	    "conflicts": "Conflicts between sources",
26	    "possible_duplicates": "Possible duplicates (not merged)",
27	    "merged_by_nickname_rule": "Merged by the nickname rule (D6)",
28	    "from_blocked_host": "From a bot-blocked company host: check in your browser (D13)",
29	    "reanchored": "Evidence re-anchored from the source text (D22)",
30	    "stale_single_source": "Single source older than 18 months (low confidence)",
31	    "c_level_not_in_proxy_undated": "C-level title not in the latest proxy, source undated",
32	    "superseded_by_proxy": "Retired by the proxy rule (D16)",
33	    "superseded_by_promotion": "Superseded by a later title",
34	    "founder_historical": "Founders without a current operating role (D23)",
35	}
36	
37	
38	def _cell(text: Any, limit: int = 160) -> str:
39	    s = " ".join(str(text if text is not None else "").split()).replace("|", "\\|")
40	    return s if len(s) <= limit else s[: limit - 1] + "…"
41	
42	
43	def parse_verifier(path: Path) -> dict[str, list[tuple[str, str, str]]]:
44	    """person -> [(field/value, verdict, reason)] from the verifier's Records table."""
45	    out: dict[str, list[tuple[str, str, str]]] = {}
46	    if not path.exists():
47	        return out
48	    header: list[str] | None = None
49	    for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
50	        if not line.startswith("|"):
51	            header = None if not line.strip() else header
52	            continue
53	        cells = [c.strip() for c in line.strip().strip("|").split("|")]
54	        if header is None:
55	            lowered = [c.lower() for c in cells]
56	            if "verdict" in lowered and "person" in lowered:
57	                header = lowered
58	            continue
59	        if set("".join(cells)) <= set("-: "):
60	            continue
61	        row = dict(zip(header, cells, strict=False))
62	        verdict = re.sub(r"[^A-Z_]", "", row.get("verdict", "").upper())
63	        if verdict in VERDICT_RANK and row.get("person"):
64	            what = f"{row.get('field', '')}: {row.get('stored value', '')}".strip(": ")
65	            out.setdefault(row["person"], []).append((what, verdict, row.get("reason", "")))
66	    return out
67	
68	
69	def _agent_verdict(rows: list[tuple[str, str, str]] | None) -> str:
70	    if not rows:
71	        return "not checked"
72	    worst = min(rows, key=lambda r: VERDICT_RANK[r[1]])
73	    counts = {v: sum(r[1] == v for r in rows) for v in VERDICT_RANK}
74	    summary = ", ".join(f"{n} {v}" for v, n in counts.items() if n)
75	    if worst[1] == "SUPPORTED":
76	        return summary
77	    return f"{summary}. Worst: {worst[0]}: {worst[2]}"
78	
79	
80	def _flags(name: str, review: dict[str, list[dict]]) -> list[str]:
81	    flags = []
82	    for key, entries in review.items():
83	        for e in entries:
84	            names = e.get("names") or [h.get("person") for h in e.get("holders", [])]
85	            if e.get("person") == name or name in (names or []):
86	                flags.append(key)
87	                break
88	    return flags
89	
90	
91	def _best_title_fact(person: dict) -> dict | None:
92	    titles = [f for f in person["facts"] if f["field"] == "title"]
93	    current = [r["title_raw"] for r in person["roles"] if r["is_current"]]
94	    for f in titles:
95	        if f["value"] in current and f["is_current"] is not False:
96	            return f
97	    return titles[0] if titles else None
98	
99	
100	def company_section(domain: str) -> str:
101	    data = json.loads((REPO_ROOT / "data" / domain / "leadership.json").read_text("utf-8"))
102	    stats, review = data["collection"], data["collection"].get("review", {})
103	    verdicts = parse_verifier(DOCS / "validation" / f"{domain}-verifier.md")
104	    people = data["people"]
105	    current = [p for p in people if any(r["is_current"] for r in p["roles"])]
106	    former = [p for p in people if p not in current]
107	
108	    out = [f"## {data['company'].get('name', domain)} ({domain})", ""]
109	    out.append(
110	        f"Documents: {stats.get('documents')} ({stats.get('documents_sent_to_llm')} sent to the "
111	        f"LLM) · claims accepted {stats.get('claims_accepted')}, rejected "
112	        f"{stats.get('claims_rejected')} · people {len(people)} ({len(current)} current) · "
113	        f"extraction cost ${stats.get('cost_usd_including_cached')} · model {stats.get('model')}"
114	    )
115	    out += ["", f"### Current leadership ({len(current)})", ""]
116	    out.append(
117	        "| # | Name | Current role(s) | Seniority / function | Confidence | Sources | "
118	        "Evidence (best) | Review flags | Agent verdict | Verified by Daniel |"
119	    )
120	    out.append("|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|")
121	    for i, p in enumerate(current, 1):
122	        roles = [r for r in p["roles"] if r["is_current"]]
123	        fact = _best_title_fact(p)
124	        evidence = (
125	            f'"{_cell(fact["evidence_snippet"], 140)}" [source]({fact["source"]["url"]})'
126	            if fact
127	            else ""
128	        )
129	        out.append(

"""Builds docs/VALIDATION.md from the committed data and the subagent reports (no LLM).

Per company: every stored person with their best evidence, the pipeline's own review lists,
the source-verifier's verdict ("Agent verdict"), and an empty "Verified by Daniel" column
for the hand-check. Hand-written sections (Known misses, notes) live in
docs/validation/<domain>-notes.md and are included verbatim, so regenerating never
overwrites them. Daniel's ticks go in that column after the last regeneration.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from leadership.config import REPO_ROOT

DOCS = REPO_ROOT / "docs"
VERDICT_RANK = {"UNSUPPORTED": 0, "PARTIAL": 1, "STALE": 2, "SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE": 3, "SUPPORTED": 4}
DANIEL = "✅ / ❌ / note"

REVIEW_TITLES = {
    "seat_conflicts": "Seat conflicts (two current holders of one C-suite seat; not decided)",
    "conflicts": "Conflicts between sources",
    "possible_duplicates": "Possible duplicates (not merged)",
    "merged_by_nickname_rule": "Merged by the nickname rule (D6)",
    "from_blocked_host": "From a bot-blocked company host: check in your browser (D13)",
    "reanchored": "Evidence re-anchored from the source text (D22)",
    "stale_single_source": "Single source older than 18 months (low confidence)",
    "c_level_not_in_proxy_undated": "C-level title not in the latest proxy, source undated",
    "superseded_by_proxy": "Retired by the proxy rule (D16)",
    "superseded_by_promotion": "Superseded by a later title",
    "founder_historical": "Founders without a current operating role (D23)",
}


def _cell(text: Any, limit: int = 160) -> str:
    s = " ".join(str(text if text is not None else "").split()).replace("|", "\\|")
    return s if len(s) <= limit else s[: limit - 1] + "…"


def parse_verifier(path: Path) -> dict[str, list[tuple[str, str, str]]]:
    """person -> [(field/value, verdict, reason)] from the verifier's Records table."""
    out: dict[str, list[tuple[str, str, str]]] = {}
    if not path.exists():
        return out
    header: list[str] | None = None
    for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        if not line.startswith("|"):
            header = None if not line.strip() else header
            continue
        cells = [c.strip() for c in line.strip().strip("|").split("|")]
        if header is None:
            lowered = [c.lower() for c in cells]
            if "verdict" in lowered and "person" in lowered:
                header = lowered
            continue
        if set("".join(cells)) <= set("-: "):
            continue
        row = dict(zip(header, cells, strict=False))
        verdict = re.sub(r"[^A-Z_]", "", row.get("verdict", "").upper())
        if verdict in VERDICT_RANK and row.get("person"):
            what = f"{row.get('field', '')}: {row.get('stored value', '')}".strip(": ")
            out.setdefault(row["person"], []).append((what, verdict, row.get("reason", "")))
    return out


def _agent_verdict(rows: list[tuple[str, str, str]] | None) -> str:
    if not rows:
        return "not checked"
    worst = min(rows, key=lambda r: VERDICT_RANK[r[1]])
    counts = {v: sum(r[1] == v for r in rows) for v in VERDICT_RANK}
    summary = ", ".join(f"{n} {v}" for v, n in counts.items() if n)
    if worst[1] == "SUPPORTED":
        return summary
    return f"{summary}. Worst: {worst[0]}: {worst[2]}"


def _flags(name: str, review: dict[str, list[dict]]) -> list[str]:
    flags = []
    for key, entries in review.items():
        for e in entries:
            names = e.get("names") or [h.get("person") for h in e.get("holders", [])]
            if e.get("person") == name or name in (names or []):
                flags.append(key)
                break
    return flags


def _best_title_fact(person: dict) -> dict | None:
    titles = [f for f in person["facts"] if f["field"] == "title"]
    current = [r["title_raw"] for r in person["roles"] if r["is_current"]]
    for f in titles:
        if f["value"] in current and f["is_current"] is not False:
            return f
    return titles[0] if titles else None


def company_section(domain: str) -> str:
    data = json.loads((REPO_ROOT / "data" / domain / "leadership.json").read_text("utf-8"))
    stats, review = data["collection"], data["collection"].get("review", {})
    verdicts = parse_verifier(DOCS / "validation" / f"{domain}-verifier.md")
    people = data["people"]
    current = [p for p in people if any(r["is_current"] for r in p["roles"])]
    former = [p for p in people if p not in current]

    out = [f"## {data['company'].get('name', domain)} ({domain})", ""]
    out.append(
        f"Documents: {stats.get('documents')} ({stats.get('documents_sent_to_llm')} sent to the "
        f"LLM) · claims accepted {stats.get('claims_accepted')}, rejected "
        f"{stats.get('claims_rejected')} · people {len(people)} ({len(current)} current) · "
        f"extraction cost ${stats.get('cost_usd_including_cached')} · model {stats.get('model')}"
    )
    out += ["", f"### Current leadership ({len(current)})", ""]
    out.append(
        "| # | Name | Current role(s) | Seniority / function | Confidence | Sources | "
        "Evidence (best) | Review flags | Agent verdict | Verified by Daniel |"
    )
    out.append("|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|")
    for i, p in enumerate(current, 1):
        roles = [r for r in p["roles"] if r["is_current"]]
        fact = _best_title_fact(p)
        evidence = (
            f'"{_cell(fact["evidence_snippet"], 140)}" [source]({fact["source"]["url"]})'
            if fact
            else ""
        )
        out.append(
            f"| {i} | {_cell(p['full_name'])} | "
            f"{_cell('; '.join(r['title_raw'] for r in roles))} | "
            f"{_cell('; '.join(r['seniority'] + '/' + r['function'] for r in roles))} | "
            f"{p['confidence']} | {p['source_count']} | {evidence} | "
            f"{_cell(', '.join(_flags(p['full_name'], review)))} | "
            f"{_cell(_agent_verdict(verdicts.get(p['full_name'])), 220)} | {DANIEL} |"
        )
    out += ["", f"### Not current (kept for history) ({len(former)})", ""]
    out.append(
        "| # | Name | Role(s) | Why not current | As of | Agent verdict | Verified by Daniel |"
    )
    out.append("|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|")
    for i, p in enumerate(former, 1):
        out.append(
            f"| {i} | {_cell(p['full_name'])} | "
            f"{_cell('; '.join(r['title_raw'] for r in p['roles']))} | "
            f"{_cell('; '.join(sorted({r['note'] or 'former' for r in p['roles']})))} | "
            f"{_cell(max((r['as_of'] or '' for r in p['roles']), default='') or 'undated')} | "
            f"{_cell(_agent_verdict(verdicts.get(p['full_name'])), 220)} | {DANIEL} |"
        )

    out += ["", "### Review lists from the pipeline", ""]
    for key, title in REVIEW_TITLES.items():
        entries = review.get(key)
        if not entries:
            continue
        out += [f"**{title}** ({len(entries)})", ""]
        for e in entries:
            out.append(f"- {_cell(_describe(key, e), 400)}")
        out.append("")

    stored = {p["full_name"] for p in people}
    rejected: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
    for r in stats.get("rejections", []):
        rejected.setdefault(r["full_name"], []).append(r)
    dropped = {n: rs for n, rs in rejected.items() if n not in stored and not _merged(n, stored)}
    out += [f"### People with every claim rejected ({len(dropped)})", ""]
    out.append("| Name | Titles claimed | Reason(s) | Example source | Verified by Daniel |")
    out.append("|---|---|---|---|---|")
    for n, rs in sorted(dropped.items()):
        out.append(
            f"| {_cell(n)} | {_cell('; '.join(sorted({r['title'] for r in rs})))} | "
            f"{_cell('; '.join(sorted({r['reason'] for r in rs})))} | [{len(rs)} claim(s)]"
            f"({rs[0]['url']}) | {DANIEL} |"
        )
    notes = DOCS / "validation" / f"{domain}-notes.md"
    if notes.exists():
        out += ["", notes.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()]
    return "\n".join(out) + "\n"


def _merged(name: str, stored: set[str]) -> bool:
    """A rejected name that is the same person (or a possible duplicate) as a stored one,
    e.g. "Jeffrey Pinner" vs "Jeff Pinner": not a dropped person."""
    from leadership.pipeline.resolve import Identity, NameRecord, compare_identity

    a = NameRecord(0, name)
    return any(compare_identity(a, NameRecord(0, s)) is not Identity.DIFFERENT for s in stored)


def _describe(key: str, e: dict) -> str:
    if key == "seat_conflicts":
        holders = "; ".join(
            f"{h['person']} ({h['title']}, as of {h['as_of'] or 'undated'})" for h in e["holders"]
        )
        return f"{e.get('seat')}: {holders}"
    if "names" in e:
        return " / ".join(e["names"])
    parts = [e.get("person", ""), e.get("title", ""), e.get("field", "")]
    if "values" in e:
        parts.append(" vs ".join(e["values"]))
    if e.get("note"):
        parts.append(e["note"])
    if "evidence_snippet" in e:
        parts.append(f'"{e["evidence_snippet"]}"')
    if "only_source" in e:
        parts.append("only source" if e["only_source"] else "also has other sources")
    urls = e.get("urls") or ([e["url"]] if e.get("url") else [])
    parts.append(" ".join(urls[:3]) + (f" (+{len(urls) - 3} more)" if len(urls) > 3 else ""))
    return " · ".join(p for p in parts if p)


HEADER = """# Validation

Generated by `leadership validation-report` from `data/<domain>/leadership.json` and the
subagent reports in `docs/validation/`. **Agent verdict** is the source-verifier's verdict
on that person's facts, an input, not an approval. **Verified by Daniel** is for the
hand-check: ✅ correct, ❌ wrong, or a note.

How to hand-check: open the evidence link, find the quoted snippet, and confirm the person,
the title, and that it is current. Records from investors.robinhood.com must be checked in a
browser (the host blocks automated clients; D13).
"""


def build(domains: list[str]) -> Path:
    text = HEADER + "".join("\n" + company_section(d) for d in domains)
    path = DOCS / "VALIDATION.md"
    path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    return path

"""Offline tests for the VALIDATION.md generator (no network, no LLM)."""

from leadership.validation_report import _agent_verdict, parse_verifier


def test_parse_verifier_reads_the_records_table(tmp_path):
    report = tmp_path / "x-verifier.md"
    report.write_text(
        "# Source verification\n\n## Records\n"
        "| # | Person | Field | Stored value | Verdict | Reason (1 line) | Source |\n"
        "|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|\n"
        "| 1 | Jane Doe | title | CFO | SUPPORTED | ok | u |\n"
        "| 2 | Jane Doe | location | SF | **PARTIAL** | interviewer's line | u |\n"
        "\n## Suspected duplicates\n| a | b |\n|---|---|\n| x | y |\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    rows = parse_verifier(report)
    assert [r[1] for r in rows["Jane Doe"]] == ["SUPPORTED", "PARTIAL"]
    verdict = _agent_verdict(rows["Jane Doe"])
    assert verdict.startswith("1 PARTIAL, 1 SUPPORTED") and "interviewer" in verdict
    assert _agent_verdict(None) == "not checked"
    assert parse_verifier(tmp_path / "missing.md") == {}

38	def _cell(text: Any, limit: int = 160) -> str:
39	    s = " ".join(str(text if text is not None else "").split()).replace("|", "\\|")

43	def parse_verifier(path: Path) -> dict[str, list[tuple[str, str, str]]]:
44	    """person -> [(field/value, verdict, reason)] from the verifier's Records table."""
45	    out: dict[str, list[tuple[str, str, str]]] = {}
46	    if not path.exists():
47	        return out
48	    header: list[str] | None = None
49	    for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
50	        if not line.startswith("|"):
51	            header = None if not line.strip() else header
52	            continue
53	        cells = [c.strip() for c in line.strip().strip("|").split("|")]
54	        if header is None:
55	            lowered = [c.lower() for c in cells]
56	            if "verdict" in lowered and "person" in lowered:
57	                header = lowered
58	            continue
59	        if set("".join(cells)) <= set("-: "):
60	            continue
61	        row = dict(zip(header, cells, strict=False))
62	        verdict = re.sub(r"[^A-Z_]", "", row.get("verdict", "").upper())
63	        if verdict in VERDICT_RANK and row.get("person"):
64	            what = f"{row.get('field', '')}: {row.get('stored value', '')}".strip(": ")
65	            out.setdefault(row["person"], []).append((what, verdict, row.get("reason", "")))
66	    return out

69	def _agent_verdict(rows: list[tuple[str, str, str]] | None) -> str:
70	    if not rows:
71	        return "not checked"
72	    worst = min(rows, key=lambda r: VERDICT_RANK[r[1]])
73	    counts = {v: sum(r[1] == v for r in rows) for v in VERDICT_RANK}
74	    summary = ", ".join(f"{n} {v}" for v, n in counts.items() if n)
75	    if worst[1] == "SUPPORTED":
76	        return summary
77	    return f"{summary}. Worst: {worst[0]}: {worst[2]}"

85	            if e.get("person") == name or name in (names or []):

181	def _merged(name: str, stored: set[str]) -> bool:
182	    """A rejected name that is the same person (or a possible duplicate) as a stored one,
183	    e.g. "Jeffrey Pinner" vs "Jeff Pinner": not a dropped person."""
184	    from leadership.pipeline.resolve import Identity, NameRecord, compare_identity
185	
186	    a = NameRecord(0, name)
187	    return any(compare_identity(a, NameRecord(0, s)) is not Identity.DIFFERENT for s in stored)

190	def _describe(key: str, e: dict) -> str:
191	    if key == "seat_conflicts":
192	        holders = "; ".join(
193	            f"{h['person']} ({h['title']}, as of {h['as_of'] or 'undated'})" for h in e["holders"]
194	        )
195	        return f"{e.get('seat')}: {holders}"
196	    if "names" in e:
197	        return " / ".join(e["names"])
198	    parts = [e.get("person", ""), e.get("title", ""), e.get("field", "")]
199	    if "values" in e:
200	        parts.append(" vs ".join(e["values"]))
201	    if e.get("note"):
202	        parts.append(e["note"])
203	    if "evidence_snippet" in e:
204	        parts.append(f'"{e["evidence_snippet"]}"')
205	    if "only_source" in e:
206	        parts.append("only source" if e["only_source"] else "also has other sources")
207	    urls = e.get("urls") or ([e["url"]] if e.get("url") else [])
208	    parts.append(" ".join(urls[:3]) + (f" (+{len(urls) - 3} more)" if len(urls) > 3 else ""))
209	    return " · ".join(p for p in parts if p)

The outcome is probably true for most but unsupported by any text. Only Warnick, Pinner and Hoge have an explicit departure statement. Use "unknown"/as_of rather than false, or require explicit evidence.
2. **Stale single-source roles left is_current=true** (Wolff 2020, Seigle 2021, Brown VP 2021). The pipeline notes the staleness in `note` but still outputs true, and these count toward people_current=25. Three of 25 "current" people are not supported as current (12% error in current headcount).
3. **Rejected evidence silently corrupts as_of/currency.** Bhatt's 2024-03-21 release lists him as CCO and Co-Founder but the claim was rejected ("evidence does not state an affiliation with Robinhood"), so the newest as_of is 2022 and he looks departed. 4. **Title selection prefers older/higher-priority source over the newest title.** Gallagher: stored "Chief Legal Officer" despite the 2026 proxy and investors page giving the longer current title (company_site priority beats sec_filing regardless of date). Recency should outweigh source priority for titles.

6. **Fact-level is_current stays true on superseded facts** (e.g. Pinner 2024 release/proxy facts true while the 8-K says separated). Role-level resolution is correct but the fact rows are misleading; review block "resolved: false" for Pinner, Warnick and Hoge is out of date.
7. **Bio and location extraction quality.** Bio picks anecdotes or prior-employer sentences (Tenev "born in Bulgaria", Bazzano's Gap years); location "San Francisco" from an interviewer's line.
8. **Blocked host dependence.** 12 of the 25 current people have investors.robinhood.com (403) as their only live-verifiable source; cached text supports them, but they need a browser re-check before release.

- "CEO & CFO" (other / c_level) and "CEO & Founder" (other / founder) for Glasgow: function "other" looks wrong for a CEO (executive/general management if the taxonomy has it). He should have one c_level row; "founder" is a flag, not a replacement for c_level seniority.
- "Co-founder / CTO" for Fernando: second row (other / founder) duplicates the first (engineering / c_level); the function should be engineering on both, and seniority is ambiguous for a dual title.
- Correct as stored: VP of Sales (sales/vp), Head of Finance & Applied AI (finance/head), Chief Marketing Officer (marketing/c_level), CTO Nichols (engineering/c_level).

## Pipeline bugs suspected (patterns, not one-offs)
1. Affiliation check ignores host domain. First-party campfire.ai bylines (Doyle, Jezienicki, Glasgow on about 70 pages) were rejected for "no affiliation with Campfire", so likely true employees are lost. Consider accepting when the page host equals the company domain and the person is a blog author.
2. Unresolved seat conflict. CTO is held both by Paul Nichols (2026-07-08) and Fernando San Martin (2024-02-27). Fernando is marked is_current=true from a single 21-month-old post, and the pipeline's own review flagged both. Dated sources should not default to current.
3. Role as_of is inconsistent with its evidence. Glasgow "CEO & CFO" as_of 2026-10-16, but its evidence dates 2026-02-24 and an undated article. The as_of seems to take the latest page date for any role.
4. Confidence "high" for Paul Nichols and John Glasgow counts derivative pages (a third-party review that restates the Anthropic case study) as independent sources. Nichols has effectively one origin.
5. Timestamps: retrieved_at/extracted_at are 2026-11-24 UTC while the run date is 2026-11-23. Likely a timezone artifact; confirm.
6. Function "other" is over-used for executive and sales roles.

def parse_verifier(path: Path) -> dict[str, list[tuple[str, str, str]]]:
    """person -> [(field/value, verdict, reason)] from the verifier's Records table."""
    out: dict[str, list[tuple[str, str, str]]] = {}
    if not path.exists():
        return out
    header: list[str] | None = None
    for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        if not line.startswith("|"):
            header = None if not line.strip() else header
            continue
        cells = [c.strip() for c in line.strip().strip("|").split("|")]
        if header is None:
            lowered = [c.lower() for c in cells]
            if "verdict" in lowered and "person" in lowered:
                # "Reason (1 line)" -> "reason": match columns by their first word.
                header = [re.sub(r"\s*\(.*\)$", "", c) for c in lowered]
            continue
        if set("".join(cells)) <= set("-: "):
            continue
        row = dict(zip(header, cells, strict=False))
        verdict = re.sub(r"[^A-Z_]", "", row.get("verdict", "").upper())
        if verdict in VERDICT_RANK and row.get("person"):
            what = f"{row.get('field', '')}: {row.get('stored value', '')}".strip(": ")
            out.setdefault(row["person"], []).append((what, verdict, row.get("reason", "")))
    return out


def _agent_verdict(rows: list[tuple[str, str, str]] | None) -> str:
    if not rows:
        return "not checked"
    worst = min(rows, key=lambda r: VERDICT_RANK[r[1]])
    counts = {v: sum(r[1] == v for r in rows) for v in VERDICT_RANK}
    summary = ", ".join(f"{n} {v}" for v, n in counts.items() if n)
    if worst[1] == "SUPPORTED":
        return summary
    return f"{summary}. Worst: {worst[0]}: {worst[2]}"

9:- **Why:** LinkedIn's User Agreement prohibits scraping. We accept the cost: weaker coverage of VPs and department heads, who often appear only there. That gap is measured (coverage-scout, also LinkedIn-free) and listed under "Known misses" in `VALIDATION.md`. The same rule covers any site whose ToS forbids automated access.
35:- **Dedupe key:** `people` is unique on `(company_id, normalized_name)`. `normalize_name` strips accents, case, punctuation, honorifics and suffixes, and middle initials. It deliberately does **not** merge nicknames ("Vlad" vs "Vladimir"). A wrong merge would combine two people's facts, which is worse than a duplicate that shows up in validation.
53:- **Close but not merged** is returned as POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE and listed in `VALIDATION.md` for Daniel to decide. This covers: same last name with matching first names but no overlapping function; same last name and same first initial; same first initial and last names at least 0.8 similar (e.g. Steven Quirk / Stephen Quirke); or whole-name similarity of 0.85 or higher.
54:- **Every non-exact merge is also listed** in `VALIDATION.md` ("merged by nickname rule"), so a wrong merge is visible.
102:- **Review:** every record whose only evidence comes from a `direct_fetch` = blocked page is marked in `VALIDATION.md` for Daniel to hand-check in a browser.

## Phase review: Phase 4 (validation report, scout and verifier runs, plus the raw_path export in 60a6431)
**Verdict:** PASS WITH FIXES
Tests: 134 passed / 0 failed · Ruff: clean (`ruff check` reports all checks passed; `ruff format --check` says 27 files already formatted)

I reviewed the current files, including your `parse_verifier` header fix. Reasons now show in the Agent verdict cells, for example `VALIDATION.md:21` "...Source is a 2020-05-21 intern post...".

**Determinism:** I did not run `leadership.cli validation-report` because it rewrites a tracked file and my rules don't allow writes. Instead I called `company_section()` twice in memory and compared the output to the file on disk: `stable True matches file True`. The generator is deterministic and the current file matches what it produces.

**Data untouched:** `git status data` is clean. Every changed line in the JSON part of 60a6431 is a `raw_path` addition or the `published_at` comma it needs. Nothing in the data was changed because of a subagent report.

### Blockers
None.

### Should fix
- **[src/leadership/validation_report.py:225-229] Regenerating wipes Daniel's ticks.** `build()` always rewrites the file with `path.write_text(text, ...)`, and the docstring at lines 7-8 only says ticks "go in that column after the last regeneration". Any re-run after the hand-check (for example, after fixing an error he finds) silently destroys his ✅/❌ marks and notes. That is exactly the hand-written content the design is supposed to protect. Fix: refuse to overwrite when the existing file has edited "Verified by Daniel" cells (anything other than `✅ / ❌ / note`), unless `--force` is passed. Or carry existing ticks over, keyed by name.
- **[validation_report.py:116-149] Location is missing from the checklist.** The spec (initial-prompt.md:135) asks for "every person, title, location, and source URL". The table has no location column. Vlad Tenev's two stored location facts (robinhood leadership.json has 2 `"field": "location"`) only appear inside the Agent verdict text and the conflicts list (VALIDATION.md:43, :66). Fix: add a Location column with its evidence and source.
- **[validation_report.py:138-149] Former people have no evidence or source link.** The "Not current" table has no Evidence/source column, so 11 stored people (VALIDATION.md:50-60) can't be checked from the checklist. Fix: add the same evidence and `[source]` cell used for current people.
- **[validation_report.py:125] Truncated evidence hides the person.** At 140 characters the snippet can end before the person or title appears. VALIDATION.md:25 (Dan Gallagher): `"Christina will work alongside our Co-Founders and Co-CEOs Baiju Bhatt and Vlad Tenev, Chief Financial Officer Jason Warnick, Chief Operatin…"`, where Gallagher's name has been cut off. :23 (Christine Brown) is cut before "VP of Product Operations". Fix: centre the excerpt on the person's name, or don't truncate the evidence cell.
- **[validation_report.py:152-155] The possible-duplicates section disappears when empty.** Empty review lists are skipped with `if not entries: continue`. Neither leadership.json has a `possible_duplicates` entry, so VALIDATION.md has no possible-duplicates section at all, even though D3/DECISIONS.md:53 says these are "listed in `VALIDATION.md`". The verifier's "Suspected duplicates" findings (none across people; duplicate role rows for Bhatt, Tenev, Glasgow and San Martin) also aren't shown. Fix: always print "Possible duplicates (0): none found", and add a line quoting the verifier's duplicate-role findings.
- **[docs/validation/robinhood.com-notes.md, Known misses table] Katelyn (KP) Perna is missing.** robinhood.com-scout.md row 10 lists "Katelyn (KP) Perna | Crypto Chief Information Security Officer | … same as #9 | 2024-06-10". She is not in leadership.json or in the notes. Doing the diff myself, the scout's "Leaders found" names missing from the data are Boyd, Erika Dean and Perna. The notes list only Dean and Boyd. Fix: add Perna, citing the same never-fetched cause as Dean.
- **[robinhood.com-notes.md, "Both found, and they agree"] Gallagher is listed as agreeing, but his title doesn't match.** The scout has "Chief Legal, Compliance and Corporate Affairs Officer". The pipeline stores "Chief Legal Officer", and the verifier (verifier.md row 14, PARTIAL) says the stored title is the older one. Fix: move Gallagher under "They disagree", as a stale title.

### Nits
- robinhood.com-notes.md: the scout's unverified candidates aren't mentioned (Gaetan Thabot, head of crypto partnerships; Sivaa Subramanian, VP Engineering through about May 2026). One line saying "unverified, not counted" would make the diff complete.
- The verifier says "collection says people_found=36 but 35 people are exported" (robinhood.com-verifier.md, Suspected duplicates section). That is wrong: its own Records table covers 36 distinct people. Worth telling Daniel, so he doesn't chase a person who isn't missing.
- meetcampfire.com-notes.md: "8 bylines" (from the rejections data) sits next to the verifier's "about 10 posts", and the verifier text says "10 rejected claims". Pick one number and say where it comes from.
- tests/test_validation_report.py covers only `parse_verifier` and `_agent_verdict`. There's no test for `company_section` (for example, that notes are included verbatim and every person gets a row) or for `_merged`.
- DECISIONS.md has no entry for the report design: hand-written notes files included verbatim, and the "worst verdict" summary. Add a short line.

### What's good
- Verdict parsing is header-driven and tolerant of `**PARTIAL**`-style bold. Agent verdicts are clearly labelled "an input, not an approval" (VALIDATION.md:5-6), which follows the "subagent reports are inputs" rule.
- The Erika Dean miss is explained honestly and checks out. Her URL is not in leadership.json or the raw cache, and company_site.py:3-4 confirms the crawler ranks pages by URL keywords.
- The Campfire Known misses claim ("None") is correct: the scout's 3 leaders (Glasgow, Arnecke, Roveda) are all in the data. The D22 affiliation rejections (Doyle, Jezienicki) are raised for Daniel to decide, not acted on.

def test_daniels_ticks_survive_regeneration():
    from leadership.validation_report import DANIEL, carry_over_ticks

    def doc(cell_a, cell_b):
        return (
            "## Acme (acme.test)\n\n### Current leadership (2)\n\n"
            "| # | Name | Role | Verified by Daniel |\n|---|---|---|---|\n"
            f"| 1 | Jane Doe | CFO | {cell_a} |\n| 2 | Bob Ray | CTO | {cell_b} |\n"
        )

    old = doc("✅", "❌ left in 2025")
    new = doc(DANIEL, DANIEL).replace("(2)", "(3)")  # counts may change between runs
    merged = carry_over_ticks(old, new)
    assert "| 1 | Jane Doe | CFO | ✅ |" in merged
    assert "| 2 | Bob Ray | CTO | ❌ left in 2025 |" in merged


def test_company_section_lists_every_person_and_includes_notes(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    import json

    import leadership.validation_report as vr

    data = tmp_path / "data" / "acme.test"
    data.mkdir(parents=True)
    (tmp_path / "docs" / "validation").mkdir(parents=True)
    source = {"url": "https://acme.test/team", "published_at": None}
    fact = {"field": "title", "value": "CFO", "evidence_snippet": "Jane Doe, CFO",
            "is_current": True, "source": source}  # fmt: skip
    people = [
        {"full_name": "Jane Doe", "confidence": "medium", "source_count": 1, "location": None,
         "roles": [{"title_raw": "CFO", "seniority": "c_level", "function": "finance",
                    "is_current": True, "as_of": None, "note": None}], "facts": [fact]},
        {"full_name": "Old Timer", "confidence": "low", "source_count": 1, "location": None,
         "roles": [{"title_raw": "COO", "seniority": "c_level", "function": "operations",
                    "is_current": False, "as_of": "2019-01-01", "note": "former"}],
         "facts": [fact | {"value": "COO", "is_current": False}]},
    ]  # fmt: skip
    (data / "leadership.json").write_text(
        json.dumps({"company": {"name": "Acme"}, "collection": {}, "people": people}), "utf-8"
    )
    (tmp_path / "docs" / "validation" / "acme.test-notes.md").write_text(
        "### Known misses\n\nHAND WRITTEN", "utf-8"
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(vr, "REPO_ROOT", tmp_path)

    assert text == vr.company_section("acme.test")  # deterministic
